sources.title: Grok 4.1 Fast and Agent Tools API, November 19, 2025
sources.evidence: Dated launch explicitly releases reasoning and non-reasoning API variants and gives 2M context. Describes reinforcement learning for tool use, without parameter counts or neural topology.
sources.parameter_reaudit_evidence: Fresh full launch read and independent HTTP 200 fetch on October 27. Trained for the real world describes RL with tools in simulated enterprise environments; State-of-the-art tool calling describes long-horizon multi-turn RL. Both exact API variants are named. No total or active parameter number and no named base checkpoint with a known count.

sources.title: Provider mapping for the unqualified Grok 4.1 Fast identifier
sources.evidence: Live metadata maps x-ai/grok-4.1-fast to canonical_slug grok-4-1-fast-non-reasoning and lists text/image input, text output, 2M context and tools. Its continued listing does not prove original-model inference remains operational.

sources.title: Original upstream variant mapping
sources.evidence: Source comments explicitly identify the catalog entry as non-reasoning and cite the ofox canonical mapping. Used to resolve the intended record identity, not as independent technical verification.

sources.title: Grok 4.1 Fast historical model documentation
sources.evidence: Exact xai.grok-4-1-fast-non-reasoning row skips thinking tokens. Documents text/image input, text output, 2,000,000 context and function calling. The provider marks retirement on August 15, 2026.
sources.parameter_reaudit_evidence: Fresh full original provider page read and HTTP 200 fetch. It says Grok 4.1 Fast improves upon Grok 4 Fast primarily through specialized training for agentic workflows. The exact non-reasoning row skips thinking tokens. Its Model Parameters section concerns sampling controls, not learned weights; no total/active count is supplied.

sources.title: May 15, 2026 model retirement
sources.evidence: Official migration table redirects grok-4-1-fast-non-reasoning to Grok 4.3 with none reasoning effort from May 15. Replacement specifications are not properties of the original release.
sources.parameter_reaudit_evidence: Fresh official migration page read. Exact grok-4-1-fast-non-reasoning redirects to grok-4.3 with none reasoning effort from May 15, 2026; a replacement is not unchanged checkpoint lineage.

sources.title: Former exact model documentation URL
sources.evidence: Direct request now redirects to the current model roster, so it cannot independently establish the original model contract. Historical launch and Oracle documentation remain accessible.

sources.title: Launch-period Enterprise Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Web-accessed terms grant limited access to hosted services and reserve the underlying technology and intellectual property to xAI. Supports a descriptive proprietary classification; output ownership does not grant ownership of model weights.

sources.title: xAI public model repository inventory
sources.evidence: Direct public organization inventory contains Grok 1 and Grok 2, with no Grok 4.1 Fast checkpoint. Considered alongside hosted distribution and reserved technology rights, without transferring old open-weight licenses.

sources.title: Grok 4.1 Model Card, November 17, 2025
sources.evidence: Downloaded and searched the complete six-page card. It describes the separate consumer Grok 4.1 model, not an exact Fast variant; no Fast parameter or network specification appears. Its November 17 launch is not transferred.
sources.parameter_reaudit_evidence: Fresh October 27 original PDF cache read: six-page November 17 standard Grok 4.1 card, configurations Grok 4.1 T/NT and section 3.1 pretraining/midtraining/SFT/RL. It is not the November 19 Fast model, contains no count, and cannot establish a counted Fast base.

sources.title: Grok 4.5 Model Card
sources.evidence: Searched the complete later card, including development and comparison sections, for the exact 4.1 Fast name, counts and architecture. No exact-model disclosure found.
sources.parameter_reaudit_evidence: Fresh October 27 complete original PDF text searched for parameters, billion/trillion, architecture, exact Fast identity and training; section 1.2 was read. Grok 4.5 has its own pretraining/midtraining/SFT/RL description; no exact Grok 4.1 Fast parameter count or counted unchanged-base relationship appears.

sources.title: Grok 4.6 Model Card
sources.evidence: Searched the complete later card and comparison material; no exact Grok 4.1 Fast parameter or network disclosure found.
sources.parameter_reaudit_evidence: Fresh October 27 complete original PDF text searched and section 1.2 read. Grok 4.5 generates SFT trajectories for 4.6; this is teacher-data lineage, not Grok 4.1 Fast weight identity or a parameter disclosure.

sources.title: Grok 4.7 Model Card
sources.evidence: Searched the complete later card and comparison material; no exact Grok 4.1 Fast parameter or network disclosure found.
sources.parameter_reaudit_evidence: Fresh October 27 complete original PDF text searched and section 1.2 read. Grok 4.6 generates SFT trajectories for 4.7; no exact Fast count, active comparison column or unchanged counted Fast base appears.

sources.title: Frontier Artificial Intelligence Framework, June 30, 2026
sources.evidence: Downloaded and searched the complete current linked framework. It discusses risk governance rather than an exact 4.1 Fast network or count. Exact-name training and interpretability searches did not locate a primary topology disclosure.
sources.parameter_reaudit_evidence: Fresh October 27 HTTP 200 original cache independently inspected, including full-text exact-name/count search. Framework discusses governance and weight security, with no exact model count. Agent direct refetch returned HTTP 403 and web open failed; the successful same-day original cache is the inspected copy.

sources.title: xAI Frontier Artificial Intelligence Framework and Data Disclosure, December 30, 2025
sources.evidence: Fresh original eleven-page PDF opened and same-day cached full text read. Data Disclosure lists training dates and trillions of training tokens for several generations, but standard Grok 4.1 is not explicitly Fast. No learned total or active count, and no named unchanged counted base for Grok 4.1 Fast.

sources.title: ADRD-Bench: A Preliminary LLM Benchmark for Alzheimer’s Disease and Related Dementias, Table 2
sources.publisher: Guangxin Zhao et al., University of Notre Dame and Indiana University
sources.evidence: Fresh original HTML and complete PDF read. Table 2 (PDF page 5) gives the exact grok-4.1-fast-non-reasoning row a dash under Model Size; reference 48 identifies the original xAI non-reasoning documentation, retrieved January 10, 2026. No active parameter column or count. This is original benchmark evidence, not xAI size disclosure.

sources.title: Agentic Proposing: Enhancing Large Language Model Reasoning via Compositional Skill Synthesis, Figure 2
sources.publisher: Zhengbo Jiao et al., Alibaba and Shanghai Jiao Tong University collaborators
sources.evidence: Fresh original HTML and full PDF inspected; Figure 2 on PDF page 3 visually verified. Its Total Parameters axis places Grok-4.1-Fast in a categorical Proprietary group, not at a numeric count. The unqualified Fast comparison is not an exact non-reasoning identification, and neither it nor the rest of the inspected comparison material establishes an active count.

sources.title: Artificial Analysis comparison: Grok 4.1 Fast Non-reasoning and DeepSeek V3
sources.evidence: Fresh indexed original comparison table explicitly leaves both Total parameters and Active parameters blank for Grok 4.1 Fast (Non-reasoning), while supplying 671B/37B for DeepSeek. Supplemental negative evidence only; direct web open failed, so the original indexed table rather than a live full-page fetch was inspected.

family.note: Part of the Grok family, specifically 4.1 Fast; separate from standard Grok 4.1.

release_date.note: Exact dated announcement releases both Fast variants. The November 17 consumer Grok 4.1 launch and January 2026 Oracle listing describe different release events.

open_weights.note: Documented distribution is a hosted model under restricted service rights. No exact public checkpoint appears in the checked official inventory.

license.note: Descriptive classification for reserved model technology and limited commercial service access.

parameters_b.note: Fresh original launch, provider, later xAI cards/frameworks and later research comparisons supply no nominal total for this exact Fast non-reasoning model. ADRD-Bench Table 2 leaves its Model Size blank. Specialized training on the Grok 4 Fast predecessor supplies no counted base; standard Grok 4.1, training-token quantities and the later Grok 4.3 replacement are not transferable parameter specifications.

active_parameters_b.note: Separately rechecked activated parameters in original sources and later comparison tables. No nominal active count or qualifying original active-count convention was found for Grok 4.1 Fast Non-Reasoning. Skipping thinking tokens does not establish neural parameter activity; later research leaves size unspecified or categorically proprietary.

architecture.note: Training descriptions do not specify Transformer, dense or MoE topology for this exact model. Later cards and targeted primary research searches supplied no exact network disclosure.

context_window.note: Original Fast context contract is two million tokens. Do not replace it with the later redirected Grok 4.3 limit.

modalities.note: Exact historical provider documentation confirms text and image inputs with text output. Tool-fetched documents and media are not additional native input modalities.

reasoning.note: This record maps to the non-reasoning mode, which skips the thinking-token phase. It is not the separately cataloged reasoning variant.

tool_call.note: Official release and exact historical provider documentation support function calling for this model.

Provider mapping for the unqualified Grok 4.1 Fast identifier

patch.notes: The catalog identifier grok-4.1-fast denotes the non-reasoning variant, mapped to native grok-4-1-fast-non-reasoning. Both Fast variants launched November 19, 2025; this is separate from the November 17 standard Grok 4.1 release. Total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed, with no counted base lineage established; neural topology is also undisclosed. Historical specifications are retained: xAI redirects this slug to Grok 4.3 with none reasoning effort from May 15, 2026, and Oracle lists the original model as retired. A provider metadata listing is not proof that original-model inference remains available.

summary: Fresh parameter review retains total and active counts as undisclosed after the exact release, provider training lineage, original xAI cards/frameworks and later original research comparisons. ADRD-Bench explicitly leaves this non-reasoning model’s size blank; Agentic Proposing places unqualified Fast in a nonnumeric proprietary group. The other twelve field assessments are preserved.

parameter_reaudit.outcome: Retain parameters_b=null and active_parameters_b=null, both undisclosed, after separate fresh review.

fresh_originals.finding: Exact Nov 19 release and RL sections; no total/active size or counted named base.
Named predecessor Grok 4 Fast and specialized agentic training, but no predecessor or target counts.
Data Disclosure training-token quantities and dates are not model parameter counts; standard 4.1 not Fast.
Complete June framework has no exact Fast or parameter-size disclosure.
Standard consumer Grok 4.1 card, not Fast.
Later 4.5 development and comparisons do not disclose Fast counts.
Later 4.6 training references generated teacher trajectories, not counted unchanged Fast lineage.
Later 4.7 training/comparisons do not establish Fast parameter counts.
Table 2 page 5 exact non-reasoning model: Model Size dash; no active column. Reference 48 pins historical model docs.
Figure 2 page 3 visually inspected: Fast belongs to categorical Proprietary group on Total Parameters axis; no numeric position usable as count.

parameter_reaudit.later_comparison_assessment: Searched total and activated counts separately. The original ADRD-Bench exact-model table gives no size and no active column. The original Agentic Proposing research-team figure supplies only a proprietary category for unqualified Fast. Artificial Analysis indexed exact-model comparison has separate total/active rows but both blank. No supported count was discarded for lacking tensor-level precision.
parameter_reaudit.lineage_assessment: Oracle explicitly describes an improvement on Grok 4 Fast through specialized training; neither model has a supplied count. xAI launch discloses RL but no counted unchanged base. Standard Grok 4.1 is a separate release. Later xAI teacher-data relationships are not same-weight guarantees, and May 15 API redirects are replacements. No size inference from shared family, speed, price, context, token volume or non-reasoning mode.
parameter_reaudit.access_limitations: Exact launch and Oracle page independently returned HTTP 200. Both later research PDFs returned HTTP 200 and were read. June framework refetch returned HTTP 403, so its successful October 27 primary-cache copy was read. OpenReview Compositional Investigation and Agentic Proposing original-submission URLs were challenge-blocked; the latter was independently read from arXiv. Compositional Investigation indexed abstract/table provided no numeric count and was not treated as full-paper evidence. Artificial Analysis comparison was inspected through the original indexed table after direct open failed.
parameter_reaudit.remaining_uncertainty: No supported nominal total or active count established for the original Grok 4.1 Fast non-reasoning model.
